title: fix: add __bold__ pattern to _inline
author: riya-dev
description:
Fixes #3.

The `__bold__` syntax was missing from `_inline`. Only `**bold**` was handled.

**Changes:**
- `src/mdlite.py`: one regex pattern added to `_inline`

**Testing:**
- Added `test_bold_underscore` in `tests/test_mdlite.py`
- All existing tests pass
diff_summary: src/mdlite.py: added `re.sub(r'__(.+?)__', r'\1', text)` to _inline, after the **bold** pattern
lesson_note: Self-merged by the maintainer — a one-liner fix with a test added. No review cycle needed for such a small, contained change. Notice how the commit message and PR description both name the specific thing that changed and why.

title: fix: escape raw HTML before inline processing
author: dev-rohan
description:
Adds `html.escape()` at the start of `_inline` so that raw HTML characters (`<`, `>`, `&`) are escaped before any regex substitution runs.

This prevents raw HTML from passing through unescaped into the output.

**Changes:**
- `src/mdlite.py`: `import html` added; `html.escape(text)` call added at the top of `_inline`

**Testing:**
- Added test for `<script>` passthrough
- Confirmed `**bold**` still renders correctly after the escape step
diff_summary: src/mdlite.py: added `import html` and `text = html.escape(text)` as first line of _inline

title: feat: support nested lists

description:
